entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey... You guys still alive?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I thought I was gonna die... Hey, will you[n]let go already!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hrgh!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: First those weird voices, then Futaba's[n]Shadow disappears...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And on top of that, there was all that,[n]"I am the one who killed my mother"[n]business.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The hell's goin' on here?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There is a difference between one's[n]cognition and the truth.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What her Shadow said isn't necessarily[n]all true.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But Futaba-chan's distortion must surely[n]have something to do with her mom...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Morgana, is it possible for a deceased[n]person to remain alive within someone's[n]cognition?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yes. Cognition is the highest form[n]of belief.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So that's why this place is a pyramid...[n]A machine for resurrecting[n]the deceased...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: She... wishes to see her mother...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yusuke...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Futaba's emotional instability might be[n]caused by her personality combining[n]with her Shadow self...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Ugh, more of this shit? I don't[n]understand a damn word you're[n]sayin'...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm talking about her having a split[n]personality. She's been too greatly[n]impacted by her Shadow.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm. It seems this battle will prove[n]a difficult one as well.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Nevertheless, we shall expose every[n]last secret of this tomb.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We did just made quite the stir in here[n]though. It'd probably be best to retreat[n]for now.
Sounds good.
My thoughts exactly.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Okay, let's just focus on getting back[n]above ground.
